name: memory-kit
description: A Claude Code plugin for developers who delegate to helper agents or run several sessions on a real repository: memory as plain dated files in the repository — injected every session, held under size caps, promoted into knowledge or rules only on your yes — hooks that guard git, secrets and the test suite, and a method for agent-orchestrated development (spec, build, review, acceptance, findings registry) as on-demand reference files and copy-on-request role templates. No database, no service.
